caption:
Reconnect every trading morning.
Broker tokens expire every day under SEBI norms, so you reconnect each morning. At 08:45 IST you get a stale-token nudge; at 09:20 IST an alert if you are connected but not armed.
KaatDo is a risk-management tool, not investment advice. KaatDo is not registered with SEBI. Broker API execution is never guaranteed.
